versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g If • HW timestamping is enabled and • CanTSyn is using for internal time measurement the same time source as the StbM for Virtual Local Time, CanTSyn shall after successful capture of the egress timestamp (refer to [SWS_CanTSyn_00150]) • calculate T4 = T0 SYNC_ns + T1 VLT - T0 VLT , with T1 VLT = T1 CAN
